agent_priors_used: Agents accumulate path dependence and salience bias: early context disproportionately shapes later tool calls, making exact replay brittle and favoring parameterized abstraction with calibrated UNKNOWN abstention - used to prioritize semantic resolve with state-conditioned reconstruction vs literal replay, distinguished from SPIDER evidence which has not shown LLM benefit vs retrieval.

Local optima and compounding horizon errors dominate: small DOM perturbations cascade without cheap verification; local repair wins only if verification is discriminating and contamination bounded - used to prioritize C-DELTA-REPAIR localized repair with AUROC/precision/contamination gates, distinguished from SPIDER evidence which has no valid repair cost measurement.

Work compression is deciding product metric: users pay total cost per successful task including retrieval/verification/repair/staleness; analytical token counting without LLM calls overstates savings (observed 5.42% synthetic margin) - used to demand end-to-end LLM+Playwright amortized cost on matched families for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, distinguished from SPIDER evidence which has zero valid cost-vs-novelty curves.

Strong baselines often match specialized memory (e.g., retrieval/RAG ~74% vs specialized ~68% on LoCoMo): without 0-token replay and RAG that hit at 0% novelty, inheritance claims are uninterpretable - used to require family-stratified block-permutation and 0% hit-rate sanity checks, distinguished from SPIDER evidence where recent exps had degenerate 0/100 baselines.

Exploration benefits are underestimated when baselines are weak and when substrate conflates body/status/headers; null distributions must respect trajectory grouping - used to require full>body and full>status non-vacuous isolation and trajectory-grouped permutation, distinguished from SPIDER evidence of vacuous C4 where full==body==status==1.0.
